title: The Bitter Cane
summary: Across the moon-sugar plantations between Corinthe and Alabaster, indebted cane-cutters and garden priests expose a planter syndicate adulterating sacred temple sugar with fever-shrine spores.

hook.rumour: Cane-cutters along the Tenmar river-bend refuse to harvest the lower fields after three boiling-vats turned ash-grey and sickened the temple tasters in Corinthe.
hook.notice: GARDEN PRIESTS OF CORINTHE & ALABASTER: Alchemists and guards needed to inspect the plantation boiling-houses and purge the blighted cane-stills.

npcs.name: Warden of Corinthe
npcs.greet: Cane-cutters along the Tenmar river-bend refuse to harvest the lower fields after three boiling-vats turned ash-grey and sickened the temple tasters in Corinthe.
talk: The trouble across Pellitine began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Corinthe.
If you mean to help the Planter Houses of Pellitine, start by checking the trail between Corinthe and Shrine of the Secunda.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Corinthe
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Shrine of the Secunda is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Shrine of the Secunda toward Jothara Citadel before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Corinthe so First Factor Shazah-Ko can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Jothara Citadel
npcs.greet: You made good time from Shrine of the Secunda. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Nera Den.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Nera Den with a picked guard.
Once Nera Den is cleared, return to Corinthe to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Corinthe
npcs.greet: First Factor Shazah-Ko awaits word on whether the crisis in Pellitine has been contained.
talk: The elders of Corinthe have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Pellitine owes you a debt for standing between Corinthe and ruin.
